## Où j'en suis

Maya and the assistant built a 3-hour SRE take-home exercise with no Kubernetes. It lives in its own private repo, `kestrel-analytics/sre-take-home`, and covers a broken alert rule, a connection leak in `flaky-svc`, and an over-broad Terraform IAM policy, plus a 4-area rubric with no cut-off. The exercise is ready, and nothing has been sent to the candidate.

- [prochaine-étape] Call the candidate Thursday at 4pm Tel Aviv time, then send the exercise and repo invite yourself.
- [essai-raté] Multi-arch `docker buildx --load` failed because the docker exporter can't load manifest lists. Compose now builds `flaky-svc` from source instead.
- [décision] Build `flaky-svc` from source in compose, with no prebuilt image (source: t06)
- [décision] The rubric has no cut-off; the panel (Maya and Noa) decides (source: t10)
- [décision] The exercise goes in its own private repo, not in infra (source: t12)
- [décision] Nothing is emailed to the candidate; Maya sends it after the call (source: t16)
